name: Southeast Fabricators
old_description: Located in Cottondale, Alabama, Southeast Fabricators, Inc. works with clients across the United States and internationally to execute best-in-class fabrication, both conventional and modular design.
about:
Southeast Fabricators, Inc. operates from Cottondale, Alabama, serving clients across the United States and internationally with conventional and modular steel fabrication. The company’s leadership includes Tim Case and Jake Case, who appear in team photos, though the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides structural steel fabrication, detailing, project management, operations programming, shipping, and floor management. It emphasizes automation and invests in technique, technology, and training to ensure quality end results. The facility’s size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

The company serves the structural steel fabrication industry, working with clients who require AISC-certified quality management. Its customer base spans domestic and international markets, though specific sectors or named clients are not listed.

Southeast Fabricators highlights that its steel fits together quickly and accurately, with clear part markings on every piece. It pursues AISC certification as a quality management system specific to the industry and points to automation as a growing differentiator in its fabrication process.
